     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""exp361 PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain — Stage-A skeleton (same-image EMA teacher, no support bank yet).
     3	
     4	Idea: continued-pretrain SOLIDER swin_tiny so the backbone learns "how to form retrievable identity
     5	evidence when a body part is missing". JEPA in LATENT body-part-token space (not pixel):
     6	  teacher (EMA, sees FULL image) -> part tokens T[B,G,C]
     7	  student (sees pose-defined PARTIAL view, some body groups masked) -> part tokens S[B,G,C]
     8	  L_part_jepa: student must PREDICT the dropped-group teacher tokens from the visible context.
     9	  L_visible_anchor: visible-group student tokens stay close to teacher (don't drift).
    10	  L_union: pooled identity token (student) close to teacher full identity token.
    11	
    12	Stage-A intentionally uses ONLY same-image EMA teacher (= codex's 3090 control "is it just OA-SD/PCVT
    13	renamed"). The MAIN novelty (pseudo same-ID support bank T_bank) is Stage-B, added on top once this

    16	Run: python psc_jepa_pretrain.py --backbone pretrained/swin_tiny.pth --data data/occluded_duke \

    39	ap.add_argument('--smoke', type=int, default=0)                  # smoke: cap #images
    40	cli = ap.parse_args()
    41	os.chdir(cli.repo); sys.path.insert(0, cli.repo)
    42	DEV = 'cuda'
    43	IMG_H, IMG_W = 384, 128
    44	GH, GW = 12, 4                                                   # swin /32 featmap grid for 384x128
    45	
    46	# --- COCO-17 keypoints -> 5 body groups (indices) ---
    47	# 0 nose,1-2 eyes,3-4 ears,5-6 shoulders,7-8 elbows,9-10 wrists,11-12 hips,13-14 knees,15-16 ankles
    48	GROUPS = {
    49	    'head':  [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],
    50	    'torso': [5, 6, 11, 12],
    51	    'larm':  [5, 7, 9],
    52	    'rarm':  [6, 8, 10],
    53	    'legs':  [11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16],
    54	}
    55	GKEYS = list(GROUPS.keys()); G = len(GKEYS)
    56	
    57	
    58	def load_pose(npz):
    59	    d = np.load(os.path.join(cli.repo, npz), allow_pickle=True)
    60	    fn = d['filenames']; vis = d['visibility'].astype(np.float32); kp = d['keypoints'].astype(np.float32)
    61	    return {fn[i]: (kp[i], vis[i]) for i in range(len(fn))}                  # name -> (kp[17,2], vis[17])
    62	
    63	
    64	class PSCDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
    65	    """image (384x128 tensor) + per-group visibility mask + per-group featmap-grid region mask."""
    66	    def __init__(self, data, pose):
    67	        self.dir = os.path.join(cli.repo, data, 'bounding_box_train')
    68	        self.pose = load_pose(pose)
    69	        self.items = [f for f in sorted(os.listdir(self.dir)) if f.endswith('.jpg') and f in self.pose]
    70	        if cli.smoke:
    71	            self.items = self.items[:cli.smoke]
    72	        self.mean = torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406]).view(3, 1, 1)
    73	        self.std = torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225]).view(3, 1, 1)
    74	
    75	    def __len__(self):
    76	        return len(self.items)
    77	
    78	    def _grid_region(self, kp, vis):
    79	        """Per-group: visibility (any kp in group visible) + bbox region mask on GHxGW grid.
    80	        @REVIEW codex: keypoints are pixel coords in the ORIGINAL crop; we read crop size and normalize
    81	        to [0,1] then to grid. If pose npz coords are already resized to 384x128, drop the /w,/h."""
    82	        gvis = np.zeros(G, np.float32); gmask = np.zeros((G, GH, GW), np.float32)
    83	        for gi, gk in enumerate(GKEYS):
    84	            idx = GROUPS[gk]
    85	            v = vis[idx]; pts = kp[idx][v >= cli.vis_thr]
    86	            if len(pts) == 0:
    87	                continue
    88	            gvis[gi] = 1.0
    89	            xs = np.clip((pts[:, 0]) * GW, 0, GW - 1e-3); ys = np.clip((pts[:, 1]) * GH, 0, GH - 1e-3)
    90	            x0, x1 = int(xs.min()), int(xs.max()); y0, y1 = int(ys.min()), int(ys.max())
    91	            gmask[gi, y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1] = 1.0
    92	        return gvis, gmask
    93	
    94	    def __getitem__(self, i):
    95	        name = self.items[i]
    96	        im = Image.open(os.path.join(self.dir, name)).convert('RGB')
    97	        ow, oh = im.size
    98	        im = im.resize((IMG_W, IMG_H))
    99	        t = torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(im, np.float32).transpose(2, 0, 1) / 255.0)
   100	        t = (t - self.mean) / self.std
   101	        kp, vis = self.pose[name]
   102	        kpn = kp.copy(); kpn[:, 0] /= max(ow, 1); kpn[:, 1] /= max(oh, 1)    # normalize to [0,1]
   103	        gvis, gmask = self._grid_region(kpn, vis)
   104	        return t, torch.from_numpy(gvis), torch.from_numpy(gmask)
   105	
   106	
   107	def build_backbone():
   108	    from model.backbones.swin_transformer import swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224
   109	    net = swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224(img_size=[IMG_H, IMG_W], drop_path_rate=0.1, drop_rate=0.0,
   110	                                       attn_drop_rate=0.0, pretrained=os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.backbone),
   111	                                       convert_weights=False, semantic_weight=cli.semantic_weight)  # H2: match downstream 0.2
   112	    net.init_weights(os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.backbone))
   113	    return net
   114	
   115	
   116	def part_pool(featmaps, gmask):
   117	    """featmaps[B,C,Hf,Wf] + gmask[B,G,Hf,Wf] -> part tokens[B,G,C] (masked avg-pool, L2)."""
   118	    B, C, Hf, Wf = featmaps.shape
   119	    if (Hf, Wf) != (GH, GW):
   120	        gmask = F.interpolate(gmask, size=(Hf, Wf), mode='nearest')
   121	    denom = gmask.sum((2, 3)).clamp_min(1.0)                                 # [B,G]
   122	    tok = torch.einsum('bchw,bghw->bgc', featmaps, gmask) / denom.unsqueeze(-1)
   123	    return F.normalize(tok, dim=2)
   124	
   125	
   126	def fwd_tokens(net, x, gmask):
   127	    out = net(x)
   128	    featmaps = out[1] if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) else out
   129	    if isinstance(featmaps, (tuple, list)):
   130	        featmaps = featmaps[-1]
   131	    return part_pool(featmaps, gmask)                                        # [B,G,C]
   132	
   133	
   134	def main():
   135	    ds = PSCDataset(cli.data, cli.pose)
   136	    bs = min(cli.bs, len(ds)) if cli.smoke else cli.bs                      # v2-Med: smoke<bs 不静默空跑
   137	    dl = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(ds, batch_size=bs, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, drop_last=(not cli.smoke))
   138	    print(f"[PSC-JEPA] {len(ds)} train imgs, {len(dl)} iters/ep, G={G} groups", flush=True)
   139	    student = build_backbone().to(DEV).train()
   140	    teacher = build_backbone().to(DEV).eval()
   141	    for p in teacher.parameters():
   142	        p.requires_grad_(False)
   143	    teacher.load_state_dict(student.state_dict())
   144	    C = student.num_features[-1]                                            # C1: asymmetric predictor (BYOL/data2vec anti-collapse)
   145	    predictor = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(C, C), nn.BatchNorm1d(C), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(C, C)).to(DEV)
   146	    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(list(student.parameters()) + list(predictor.parameters()), lr=cli.lr, weight_decay=0.05)
   147	    os.makedirs(os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.out), exist_ok=True)
   148	    for ep in range(cli.epochs):
   149	        last = {}
   150	        for it, (x, gvis, gmask) in enumerate(dl):
   151	            x, gvis, gmask = x.to(DEV), gvis.to(DEV), gmask.to(DEV)          # [B,3,H,W],[B,G],[B,G,GH,GW]
   152	            B = x.shape[0]
   153	            # teacher sees FULL image
   154	            with torch.no_grad():
   155	                T = fwd_tokens(teacher, x, gmask)                            # [B,G,C]
   156	            # student sees PARTIAL: drop `drop_groups` visible groups by masking image region
   157	            drop = torch.zeros(B, G, device=DEV)
   158	            for b in range(B):
   159	                vis_g = torch.where(gvis[b] > 0)[0]
   160	                nd = min(cli.drop_groups, max(0, len(vis_g) - 1))           # M1: keep >=1 visible, 不排除重遮挡样本(目标人群)
   161	                if nd > 0:
   162	                    sel = vis_g[torch.randperm(len(vis_g), device=DEV)[:nd]]
   163	                    drop[b, sel] = 1.0
   164	            # build image-space drop mask from grid region of dropped groups
   165	            dmask_grid = (gmask * drop.unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1).clamp(0, 1)   # [B,GH,GW]
   166	            dmask_img = F.interpolate(dmask_grid.unsqueeze(1), size=(IMG_H, IMG_W), mode='nearest')
   167	            x_part = x * (1.0 - dmask_img)                                   # zero-out dropped region (post-norm≈mean, ok as occlusion)
   168	            S = fwd_tokens(student, x_part, gmask)                           # [B,G,C]
   169	            Sp = F.normalize(predictor(S.reshape(-1, C)).reshape(B, G, C), dim=2)  # C1: predictor(student) predicts teacher
   170	            # losses (cosine in latent token space, predictor-asymmetric)
   171	            cos = (Sp * T).sum(2)                                          # [B,G] predicted-vs-teacher sim
   172	            drop_m = drop * gvis                                           # only dropped & originally-visible
   173	            vis_m = (1.0 - drop) * gvis                                     # visible & kept
   174	            L_jepa = ((1.0 - cos) * drop_m).sum() / drop_m.sum().clamp_min(1.0)   # predict dropped from context
   175	            L_anchor = ((1.0 - cos) * vis_m).sum() / vis_m.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
   176	            su = F.normalize(predictor((S * gvis.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1)), dim=1)   # union identity token (predicted)
   177	            tu = F.normalize((T * gvis.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1), dim=1)
   178	            L_union = (1.0 - (su * tu).sum(1)).mean()
   179	            vmask = gvis.reshape(-1).bool()                                 # v2-High: only visible-group tokens (drop zero-vectors)
   180	            Svis = S.reshape(-1, C)[vmask]
   181	            std_s = (Svis.std(0) * (C ** 0.5)) if Svis.shape[0] > 1 else torch.ones(C, device=DEV)  # ×√C: healthy≈1, collapse→0
   182	            L_var = F.relu(1.0 - std_s).mean()                              # target 1 now reachable
   183	            loss = cli.w_jepa * L_jepa + cli.w_anchor * L_anchor + cli.w_union * L_union + cli.w_var * L_var
   184	            opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step()
   185	            # EMA teacher update
   186	            with torch.no_grad():
   187	                for ps, pt in zip(student.parameters(), teacher.parameters()):
   188	                    pt.mul_(cli.ema).add_(ps.detach(), alpha=1 - cli.ema)
   189	            last = dict(L=loss.item(), jepa=L_jepa.item(), anchor=L_anchor.item(), union=L_union.item(),
   190	                        var=L_var.item(), tok_std=std_s.mean().item(),       # C1(v2): √C-scaled healthy≈1, <0.5=坍缩警戒
   191	                        cos_drop=(cos * drop_m).sum().item() / drop_m.sum().clamp_min(1).item())
   192	            if it % 50 == 0:
   193	                print(f"  ep{ep} it{it}/{len(dl)} L={last['L']:.4f} jepa={last['jepa']:.4f} anchor={last['anchor']:.4f} "
   194	                      f"union={last['union']:.4f} var={last['var']:.4f} tokStd={last['tok_std']:.3f} cosDrop={last['cos_drop']:.3f}", flush=True)
   195	        print(f"[epoch {ep}] " + " ".join(f"{k}={v:.4f}" for k, v in last.items()), flush=True)
   196	        if (ep + 1) % cli.save_every == 0 or ep == cli.epochs - 1:
   197	            sd = {f"backbone.{k}": v for k, v in student.state_dict().items()}  # H1: backbone. prefix for downstream init_weights
   198	            torch.save({'state_dict': sd}, os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.out, f"pscjepa_{ep+1}.pth"))
   199	            print(f"[save] pscjepa_{ep+1}.pth ({len(sd)} keys, backbone. prefix)", flush=True)
   200	    print("[done] PSC-JEPA stage-A pretrain complete.")

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/design.md:1:# exp361 — PSC-JEPA：Pose-defined Support-Complete JEPA pretraining（范式转向核心 build）
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/design.md:5:范式转向（用户授权换量级）→ 3 路 gap → Intruder(C-#2) 选中 → **Intruder DEAD**（exp360 阶段0.5 因果证伪：donor-ID 可读但压它不救排序，H2 #false 控制 + rank-r projection 双证）→ codex 裁决转 **B PSC-JEPA(6.5)**。这是真正的 continued-pretrain 换量级，不是 frozen probe。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/design.md:9:给一张**不完整人体图**（pose-defined 部分遮挡），让 backbone 在 **latent body-part token 空间预测"完整身份 support"**——target 来自 EMA full-view teacher + 高置信 pseudo same-ID support bank。**不补像素、不补语义比例，而是补"身份证据"**。JEPA 路线：预测 embedding target 而非像素，避开 ReID 中重建背景/遮挡物的污染。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/design.md:11:贴项目 exp109 oracle 证据：support-complete teacher 有真实 headroom（oracle 61.88/73.26 → 70.40/81.36），PSC-JEPA 把这个 headroom 尝试**蒸进预训练**（不像 exp109/FGEU 是测试端不可得的 oracle）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/design.md:16:**没吃掉的窄缝**：① 补身份 support 非像素 ② support bank/pseudo cross-view teacher 非 single-image MAE ③ pretraining 学"缺部位时如何形成可检索身份证据" ④ JEPA latent prediction。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/design.md:24:4. **loss**：`L_part_jepa`(missing token 预测 teacher/support, cos/L2) + `L_union`(union token ≈ full-view identity) + `L_gram`(part-token 关系矩阵对齐) + `L_visible_anchor`(可见 part 不被改坏) + `L_solider/dino_anchor`(可见区蒸原 backbone, 防遗忘) + 可选 `L_cluster_contrast`(高置信 pseudo cluster)。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/design.md:31:| 4090 | **PSC-JEPA 主跑**（SOLIDER/Swin-Tiny multi-dataset 50-100ep）| 主结果 |
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/design.md:38:- **阶段 A 骨架**：continued-pretrain loop（SOLIDER init + EMA teacher + partial-view pretext + `L_part_jepa`+`L_union`+`L_visible_anchor`，先不加 support bank）→ smoke 跑通 + 不崩。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:14:Review file experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/psc_jepa_pretrain.py (PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain stage-A, SOLIDER swin_tiny backbone 训练, codex 三审 Round 1/3)。机制: EMA teacher 看 full image→body-part latent tokens; student 看 pose-defined partial view(mask drop_groups 个可见 body group 的图像区域)→在 latent part-token 空间用 predictor 预测被 drop 的 teacher tokens(L_part_jepa cos)+L_visible_anchor+L_union+L_var(VICReg variance hinge std×sqrt(C) gvis掩码)。EMA 更新 teacher。已修: predictor BYOL 防坍缩, ckpt backbone.前缀, semantic_weight 0.2, drop 自适应留≥1可见, var/监控 sqrt(C)标定 healthy约1。全量逐行查: (a)表征坍缩 predictor+var-reg 够吗 teacher 会坍缩吗 (b)坐标系 keypoints 原crop像素 normalize ow,oh→12x4 grid 对吗 (c)swin featmaps self.base(x) 返回 featmaps[B,C,12,4] 4D fwd_tokens out[1]/out[-1] 解析对吗 (d)part_pool einsum/EMA update/predictor reshape 维度/BatchNorm1d 在 B*G batch/数值安全 (e)backbone init_weights+ckpt 往返 load (f)novelty: latent body-part JEPA for occluded ReID continued-pretrain vs PersonMAE/HAP/I-JEPA 先例。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。务实中文。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp361 PSC-JEPA Stage-A (`psc_jepa_pretrain.py`)
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:6:**Scope**: `psc_jepa_pretrain.py` 全文逐行 + `design.md` + 对照 `model/backbones/swin_transformer.py`、`model/make_model.py`、`config/defaults.py`、`datasets/pose_dataset.py`
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:7:**结论先行**: **需修复后重审**。坐标系 / swin shape 解析 / masked-pool / EMA 逻辑都正确，但存在 1 个 Critical（表征坍缩机制缺失）+ 3 个 High（checkpoint 存盘格式与本仓 loader 不兼容、semantic_weight 与下游不一致、pose npz 前置缺失），任何一个都可能让这次多天 continued-pretrain 白跑或下游加载即崩。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:13:### 1. JEPA 表征坍缩（最关键）— 不通过
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:14:- 当前 loss 全是 `1 - cos(student_token, EMA_teacher_token)`，三项（L_jepa / L_anchor / L_union）都把 student token 直接拉向 teacher token。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:15:- **没有 predictor / projector 头**，没有 variance-covariance 正则（VICReg），没有 centering+sharpening（DINO），没有 target normalization（data2vec），没有负样本。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:16:- 这是 **BYOL / SimSiam 去掉 predictor** 的退化配置。SimSiam(CVPR21) 与 BYOL 系列消融均证实：predictor 是防坍缩的核心，去掉 predictor 必坍缩（L2-normalized 特征 std→0、loss→最小）。I-JEPA / data2vec（与本设计最像：EMA full teacher + masked student 预测 latent）都带 predictor/regression head 且对 target 做归一化——本脚本两者皆无。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:20:- **修复建议（至少其一，推荐前两条同上）**：(a) student 侧加非对称 predictor MLP；(b) 加 VICReg variance hinge `relu(1-std(S))` 强制每维 std≥1；(c) teacher token 做 batch centering（DINO）或 instance-norm（data2vec）；(d) 日志加 `S` 的 per-dim std 与 effective rank，kill-switch 切到 std。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:29:### 3. swin featmaps shape 解析 — 通过
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:31:- `fwd_tokens`: `out[1]`=outs_list → `[-1]`=stage3 featmap。384×128 输入下 stage3 输出空间 = **(12,4) = (GH,GW)**，`num_features[-1]=768`。`part_pool` 里 `(Hf,Wf)!=(GH,GW)` 判定为 False，不触发 interpolate。解析稳健、shape 假设正确。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:40:- `convert_weights=False` 与本仓一致：`make_model.py:190` 仅 imagenet 用 True，SOLIDER 格式 swin_tiny.pth 用 False；`init_weights` 按 `backbone.` 前缀过滤加载，正是 SOLIDER ckpt 格式。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:44:- 不是换名小调参：确是 JEPA 式 latent part-token 自蒸馏 continued-pretrain loop。novelty 在 Stage-B support bank（design 已申明 Stage-A 是"是否=OA-SD/PCVT 换名"的对照），Stage-A 作骨架合理。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:52:- **C1 表征坍缩机制缺失**：无 predictor / 无 variance-covariance / 无 centering / 无负样本，等价 BYOL-去-predictor，全局常数解可达；`cosDrop→1` 监控把坍缩读成成功（假阳性 smoke）。需加防坍缩组件 + per-dim std/rank 监控，kill-switch 改用 std。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:55:- **H1 checkpoint 存盘格式与本仓 loader 不兼容**：`torch.save(student.state_dict())` 存的是裸 SwinTransformer 键（`patch_embed... / stages...`，**无 `backbone.` 前缀**）。下游 `init_weights` 只保留 `backbone.` 前缀键 → 过滤后 state_dict 为空 → `list(state_dict.keys())[0]` **IndexError**（或啥都没加载）。**整条 pretrain→fine-tune 链路因此断裂**，违背 design 的"fine-tune 兼容"首要目标。修复：存 `{'state_dict': {f'backbone.{k}': v for k,v in student.state_dict().items()}}`（init_weights 会自动 strip `backbone.`）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:56:- **H2 semantic_weight 不一致**：`build_backbone` 硬编码 `semantic_weight=1.0`，但**所有**下游 swin_tiny 配置用 `SEMANTIC_WEIGHT: 0.2`。SOLIDER 前向 `x*softplus(sw)+sb` 随 semantic_weight 变，1.0 下预训练的 conv/attn 权重在 0.2 下 fine-tune/测试时激活分布偏移，可能直接抹掉 ≥+0.7 mAP 的 kill-switch 余量。应改为 0.2（或设成 CLI 参数并默认对齐下游）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:60:- **M1 重遮挡样本被排除出 JEPA loss**：`if len(vis_g) > drop_groups` 才 drop；可见 group ≤ drop_groups（=2）的**重遮挡样本一个都不 drop → drop_m=0 → 不进 L_jepa**。恰恰把方法目标人群（occluded）排除在主信号外，训练偏向易样本。建议 `drop = min(drop_groups, len(vis_g)-1)`。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:68:- **L3** `DEV='cuda'` 硬编码，无 CPU/设备回退；全不可见样本 → `L_union=1` 常数项（罕见）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:75:坐标系、swin shape 解析、masked-avg-pool、EMA、backbone init 这些"易错点"实现都正确，作者对数据流把握扎实。但 **C1 坍缩风险 + 监控测不出坍缩** 是头号科学风险，**H1 存盘格式断链** 会让整条 pretrain→fine-tune 失效，**H2 semantic_weight 失配** 可能吞掉 kill-switch 余量，**H3 pose npz** 是运行前置。这些必须先修：
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:76:1. 加 predictor/VICReg/centering 之一 + per-dim std/rank 日志，kill-switch 改用 std（C1）；
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:78:3. semantic_weight 对齐下游 0.2（H2）；
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:90:**Reviewer**: Claude (Opus, 独立 v2)　**Date**: 2026-06-26　**Round**: v2　**Scope**: 与 v1 同范围全量（`psc_jepa_pretrain.py` 逐行 + design + 实测对照 `swin_transformer.py:init_weights/forward/num_features`、`make_model.py`、`datasets/pose_dataset.py`、`config/defaults.py` 与各 swin_tiny config）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:92:**结论先行**：v1 的 4 个修复点里 **H1 / H2 / M1 全部正确修复，C1 只修对了一半**。predictor（防坍缩主力）实现正确，但新加的 **VICReg variance hinge + tok_std 监控对 L2-normalized token 的标定整体错位**，这是本轮新发现的 1 个 **High**——它让 C1 fix 的第二个目标（可靠监控坍缩 / kill-switch）依然不成立，且把 var 正则做成了永远不满足的饱和项。另有 M2（bbox 重叠，未处理）、smoke<bs 静默空跑（新 Medium）。**verdict 仍为需修复后重审**。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:98:- **H1 ckpt 前缀 — 正确（已对 loader 实测）**。`init_weights`（swin_transformer.py:1341）取 `ckpt['state_dict']`，1352-1354 只保留 `backbone.` 前缀键并 `k[9:]` 剥前缀，1393 `load_state_dict(state_dict, False)`。exp361 存 `{'state_dict':{f'backbone.{k}':v}}` 正好命中；剥完前缀=裸 swin 键，与 `self.base` 完全匹配；1357 的 `keys()[0]` 不会 IndexError（所有键都过滤通过、非空）。与原 SOLIDER ckpt 同格式，往返一致。**断链已修复**。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:99:- **H2 semantic_weight — 正确（含 1 个提醒）**。cli 默认 0.2，与**所有** swin_tiny config（`SEMANTIC_WEIGHT: 0.2`）一致，student/teacher 同走 0.2，forward(1396-1405) 用 `self.semantic_weight`。⚠️ 提醒：`config/defaults.py:79` 仍是 1.0，下游 fine-tune **必须用带 0.2 override 的 config**（现有都带），否则又会失配——非本脚本 bug，但要在启动 fine-tune 时确认。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:100:- **M1 自适应 drop — 正确**。`nd=min(drop_groups,max(0,len(vis_g)-1))`：vis=0/1→nd=0（不 drop，保≥1 可见上下文）；vis=2→drop 1 留 1（**重遮挡目标人群已纳入 L_jepa**）；vis=5→drop 2 留 3。仅"恰好 1 可见 group"样本不进 L_jepa（无法构成 predict-dropped-from-visible 任务，不可避免），但仍进 L_anchor/L_union。逻辑正确。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:104:- `S=fwd_tokens(...)` 末端经 `part_pool→F.normalize(tok,dim=2)`，**S 是单位向量**，不是修复说明里写的"raw S"。对 C=768 的单位向量，逐维 std 的均值 **恒 ≤ 1/√C ≈ 0.036**（因 Σ_i Var≤E‖x‖²=1）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:105:- 后果①：`L_var=relu(1.0-std_s).mean()` 的目标 std≥1.0 **数学上不可达**，L_var 恒≈0.96（健康）↔1.0（坍缩），几乎不动 → 作为"VICReg variance floor"是**永远饱和、永不满足**的项（梯度方向上仍轻微推 spread，但绝非设计意图的方差地板）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:126:- L2 全不可见样本 → `L_union=1.0` 常数项（罕见）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:140:**Reviewer**: Claude (Opus, 独立 v3)　**Date**: 2026-06-26　**Round**: v3　**Scope**: 与 v1/v2 同范围全量（`psc_jepa_pretrain.py` 逐行 + design + 实测对照 `swin_transformer.py:init_weights(1337-1394)/forward(1396-1429)/num_features`、`pose_dataset.py`、`make_model.py`、`config/defaults.py`）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:146:- **L_var 行为**：`relu(1−std_s).mean()` 各向同性→0；真实各向异性→>0 且只惩罚 std_s<1 的低方差维（每维差异化梯度，非 v2"全维恒定 0.964 永不达 0"），是有效 VICReg 方差地板，提供持续温和白化/抗坍缩压力。注意 √C 重标定使 L_var 对 student 的梯度比 v2 约强 √C≈27.7×（intended：predictor 仍是主防线，var 为后备；w_var=1.0 量级与 L_jepa 相当）→ 见 L1。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:162:- **判为非阻断**，理由：① 重叠是局部带状非整体（drop≤2 且 `nd=min(2,len(vis)−1)` 恒留≥1 可见 → 绝不清空全身，head/小腿/外侧臂存活，partial-view 任务不退化）；② 不崩、不 NaN、不威胁 Stage-A 稳定性目标（design 明定 Stage-A 目标=smoke 跑通+不崩）；③ 主信号 L_jepa（dropped 组）不受此污染，受影响仅 L_anchor 且为软污染（可视作温和 JEPA）；④ design 明确分阶段、novelty 裁决推迟到 Stage-C 带对照。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:166:- 既有正确点复核无回退：kpn 按原 crop 归一化、resize 纯缩放不变、grid clip 无 off-by-one、einsum masked-pool、`denom.clamp_min(1)`、`normalize(0)=0`、EMA over `parameters()`（swin 仅常量 buffer `relative_position_index`）、ckpt `backbone.` 前缀（对 `init_weights:1352-1354` 剥前缀往返一致、`keys()[0]` 不空）、semantic_weight 0.2 对齐下游——v1/v2 已逐项确认。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:169:- L1 w_var √C-标定后梯度 ~27× 于 v2（intended，留意是否过度白化，可调 w_var）；L2 union 路 0 可见 → L_union=1 常数（罕见）；L3 `DEV='cuda'` 硬编码；L4 predictor 同模块每 step 被 part[320,C]/union[64,C] 两次前向（各用自身 batch 统计、不存盘 → 无害）；L5 无 AMP/warmup/cosine、EMA 不 ramp——次优非错。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:173:- semantic_weight：fine-tune 必须用带 `SEMANTIC_WEIGHT 0.2` override 的 config（`defaults.py:79` 仍 1.0）——非本脚本 bug，启动 fine-tune 时确认。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:176:预防坍缩（predictor 非对称 + EMA stop-grad，v2 已确认）与**监控/正则坍缩**（√C-标定 std-floor + 0.5 阈值 + gvis 掩码，本轮新确认）两条线**均成立**——v2 唯一 High 已正确闭合。smoke 修复正确。M2 维持 Medium 但属 Stage-A 可接受、非阻断的设计权衡，列 Stage-B TODO。本轮无 Critical、无 High；仅 1 个窄 Low（smoke 末批 BN）+ 既有 Low + H3/semantic_weight 数据/配置前置。Medium（M2）带条件接受。

Stage 2 PSG does NOT affect `featmaps[-1]` directly -- it only affects Stage 2 features which are then downsampled and passed through Stage 3. Stage 2 PSG indirectly affects Stage 3 features via the information flow: Stage 2 PSG -> downsample -> Stage 3 blocks (with Stage 3 PSG) -> featmaps[-1].
./experiments/exp252/claude_review.md:171:When `_lgpa_detach=True`, LGPA operates on `featmaps[-1].detach()`, so LGPA gradients do NOT flow back through Stage 2 or Stage 3 PSG. CORRECT.

./experiments/exp252/claude_review.md:175:Stage 2 features: `featmaps[-2]` is passed to GCN as `stage2_feat` (L531). With multi-stage PSG, this Stage 2 output is now PSG+PAA modulated. This means GCN gets pose-enhanced Stage 2 features. This is a FEATURE, not a bug -- it's part of the expected behavior of multi-stage injection.

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp361 PSC-JEPA Stage-A (`psc_jepa_pretrain.py`)
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:6:**Scope**: `psc_jepa_pretrain.py` 全文逐行 + `design.md` + 对照 `model/backbones/swin_transformer.py`、`model/make_model.py`、`config/defaults.py`、`datasets/pose_dataset.py`
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:7:**结论先行**: **需修复后重审**。坐标系 / swin shape 解析 / masked-pool / EMA 逻辑都正确，但存在 1 个 Critical（表征坍缩机制缺失）+ 3 个 High（checkpoint 存盘格式与本仓 loader 不兼容、semantic_weight 与下游不一致、pose npz 前置缺失），任何一个都可能让这次多天 continued-pretrain 白跑或下游加载即崩。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:13:### 1. JEPA 表征坍缩（最关键）— 不通过
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:14:- 当前 loss 全是 `1 - cos(student_token, EMA_teacher_token)`，三项（L_jepa / L_anchor / L_union）都把 student token 直接拉向 teacher token。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:15:- **没有 predictor / projector 头**，没有 variance-covariance 正则（VICReg），没有 centering+sharpening（DINO），没有 target normalization（data2vec），没有负样本。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:16:- 这是 **BYOL / SimSiam 去掉 predictor** 的退化配置。SimSiam(CVPR21) 与 BYOL 系列消融均证实：predictor 是防坍缩的核心，去掉 predictor 必坍缩（L2-normalized 特征 std→0、loss→最小）。I-JEPA / data2vec（与本设计最像：EMA full teacher + masked student 预测 latent）都带 predictor/regression head 且对 target 做归一化——本脚本两者皆无。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:20:- **修复建议（至少其一，推荐前两条同上）**：(a) student 侧加非对称 predictor MLP；(b) 加 VICReg variance hinge `relu(1-std(S))` 强制每维 std≥1；(c) teacher token 做 batch centering（DINO）或 instance-norm（data2vec）；(d) 日志加 `S` 的 per-dim std 与 effective rank，kill-switch 切到 std。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:29:### 3. swin featmaps shape 解析 — 通过
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:31:- `fwd_tokens`: `out[1]`=outs_list → `[-1]`=stage3 featmap。384×128 输入下 stage3 输出空间 = **(12,4) = (GH,GW)**，`num_features[-1]=768`。`part_pool` 里 `(Hf,Wf)!=(GH,GW)` 判定为 False，不触发 interpolate。解析稳健、shape 假设正确。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:40:- `convert_weights=False` 与本仓一致：`make_model.py:190` 仅 imagenet 用 True，SOLIDER 格式 swin_tiny.pth 用 False；`init_weights` 按 `backbone.` 前缀过滤加载，正是 SOLIDER ckpt 格式。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:44:- 不是换名小调参：确是 JEPA 式 latent part-token 自蒸馏 continued-pretrain loop。novelty 在 Stage-B support bank（design 已申明 Stage-A 是"是否=OA-SD/PCVT 换名"的对照），Stage-A 作骨架合理。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:52:- **C1 表征坍缩机制缺失**：无 predictor / 无 variance-covariance / 无 centering / 无负样本，等价 BYOL-去-predictor，全局常数解可达；`cosDrop→1` 监控把坍缩读成成功（假阳性 smoke）。需加防坍缩组件 + per-dim std/rank 监控，kill-switch 改用 std。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:55:- **H1 checkpoint 存盘格式与本仓 loader 不兼容**：`torch.save(student.state_dict())` 存的是裸 SwinTransformer 键（`patch_embed... / stages...`，**无 `backbone.` 前缀**）。下游 `init_weights` 只保留 `backbone.` 前缀键 → 过滤后 state_dict 为空 → `list(state_dict.keys())[0]` **IndexError**（或啥都没加载）。**整条 pretrain→fine-tune 链路因此断裂**，违背 design 的"fine-tune 兼容"首要目标。修复：存 `{'state_dict': {f'backbone.{k}': v for k,v in student.state_dict().items()}}`（init_weights 会自动 strip `backbone.`）。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:56:- **H2 semantic_weight 不一致**：`build_backbone` 硬编码 `semantic_weight=1.0`，但**所有**下游 swin_tiny 配置用 `SEMANTIC_WEIGHT: 0.2`。SOLIDER 前向 `x*softplus(sw)+sb` 随 semantic_weight 变，1.0 下预训练的 conv/attn 权重在 0.2 下 fine-tune/测试时激活分布偏移，可能直接抹掉 ≥+0.7 mAP 的 kill-switch 余量。应改为 0.2（或设成 CLI 参数并默认对齐下游）。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:60:- **M1 重遮挡样本被排除出 JEPA loss**：`if len(vis_g) > drop_groups` 才 drop；可见 group ≤ drop_groups（=2）的**重遮挡样本一个都不 drop → drop_m=0 → 不进 L_jepa**。恰恰把方法目标人群（occluded）排除在主信号外，训练偏向易样本。建议 `drop = min(drop_groups, len(vis_g)-1)`。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:68:- **L3** `DEV='cuda'` 硬编码，无 CPU/设备回退；全不可见样本 → `L_union=1` 常数项（罕见）。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:75:坐标系、swin shape 解析、masked-avg-pool、EMA、backbone init 这些"易错点"实现都正确，作者对数据流把握扎实。但 **C1 坍缩风险 + 监控测不出坍缩** 是头号科学风险，**H1 存盘格式断链** 会让整条 pretrain→fine-tune 失效，**H2 semantic_weight 失配** 可能吞掉 kill-switch 余量，**H3 pose npz** 是运行前置。这些必须先修：
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:76:1. 加 predictor/VICReg/centering 之一 + per-dim std/rank 日志，kill-switch 改用 std（C1）；
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:78:3. semantic_weight 对齐下游 0.2（H2）；
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:90:**Reviewer**: Claude (Opus, 独立 v2)　**Date**: 2026-06-26　**Round**: v2　**Scope**: 与 v1 同范围全量（`psc_jepa_pretrain.py` 逐行 + design + 实测对照 `swin_transformer.py:init_weights/forward/num_features`、`make_model.py`、`datasets/pose_dataset.py`、`config/defaults.py` 与各 swin_tiny config）。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:92:**结论先行**：v1 的 4 个修复点里 **H1 / H2 / M1 全部正确修复，C1 只修对了一半**。predictor（防坍缩主力）实现正确，但新加的 **VICReg variance hinge + tok_std 监控对 L2-normalized token 的标定整体错位**，这是本轮新发现的 1 个 **High**——它让 C1 fix 的第二个目标（可靠监控坍缩 / kill-switch）依然不成立，且把 var 正则做成了永远不满足的饱和项。另有 M2（bbox 重叠，未处理）、smoke<bs 静默空跑（新 Medium）。**verdict 仍为需修复后重审**。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:98:- **H1 ckpt 前缀 — 正确（已对 loader 实测）**。`init_weights`（swin_transformer.py:1341）取 `ckpt['state_dict']`，1352-1354 只保留 `backbone.` 前缀键并 `k[9:]` 剥前缀，1393 `load_state_dict(state_dict, False)`。exp361 存 `{'state_dict':{f'backbone.{k}':v}}` 正好命中；剥完前缀=裸 swin 键，与 `self.base` 完全匹配；1357 的 `keys()[0]` 不会 IndexError（所有键都过滤通过、非空）。与原 SOLIDER ckpt 同格式，往返一致。**断链已修复**。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:99:- **H2 semantic_weight — 正确（含 1 个提醒）**。cli 默认 0.2，与**所有** swin_tiny config（`SEMANTIC_WEIGHT: 0.2`）一致，student/teacher 同走 0.2，forward(1396-1405) 用 `self.semantic_weight`。⚠️ 提醒：`config/defaults.py:79` 仍是 1.0，下游 fine-tune **必须用带 0.2 override 的 config**（现有都带），否则又会失配——非本脚本 bug，但要在启动 fine-tune 时确认。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:100:- **M1 自适应 drop — 正确**。`nd=min(drop_groups,max(0,len(vis_g)-1))`：vis=0/1→nd=0（不 drop，保≥1 可见上下文）；vis=2→drop 1 留 1（**重遮挡目标人群已纳入 L_jepa**）；vis=5→drop 2 留 3。仅"恰好 1 可见 group"样本不进 L_jepa（无法构成 predict-dropped-from-visible 任务，不可避免），但仍进 L_anchor/L_union。逻辑正确。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:104:- `S=fwd_tokens(...)` 末端经 `part_pool→F.normalize(tok,dim=2)`，**S 是单位向量**，不是修复说明里写的"raw S"。对 C=768 的单位向量，逐维 std 的均值 **恒 ≤ 1/√C ≈ 0.036**（因 Σ_i Var≤E‖x‖²=1）。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:105:- 后果①：`L_var=relu(1.0-std_s).mean()` 的目标 std≥1.0 **数学上不可达**，L_var 恒≈0.96（健康）↔1.0（坍缩），几乎不动 → 作为"VICReg variance floor"是**永远饱和、永不满足**的项（梯度方向上仍轻微推 spread，但绝非设计意图的方差地板）。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:126:- L2 全不可见样本 → `L_union=1.0` 常数项（罕见）。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:140:**Reviewer**: Claude (Opus, 独立 v3)　**Date**: 2026-06-26　**Round**: v3　**Scope**: 与 v1/v2 同范围全量（`psc_jepa_pretrain.py` 逐行 + design + 实测对照 `swin_transformer.py:init_weights(1337-1394)/forward(1396-1429)/num_features`、`pose_dataset.py`、`make_model.py`、`config/defaults.py`）。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:146:- **L_var 行为**：`relu(1−std_s).mean()` 各向同性→0；真实各向异性→>0 且只惩罚 std_s<1 的低方差维（每维差异化梯度，非 v2"全维恒定 0.964 永不达 0"），是有效 VICReg 方差地板，提供持续温和白化/抗坍缩压力。注意 √C 重标定使 L_var 对 student 的梯度比 v2 约强 √C≈27.7×（intended：predictor 仍是主防线，var 为后备；w_var=1.0 量级与 L_jepa 相当）→ 见 L1。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:162:- **判为非阻断**，理由：① 重叠是局部带状非整体（drop≤2 且 `nd=min(2,len(vis)−1)` 恒留≥1 可见 → 绝不清空全身，head/小腿/外侧臂存活，partial-view 任务不退化）；② 不崩、不 NaN、不威胁 Stage-A 稳定性目标（design 明定 Stage-A 目标=smoke 跑通+不崩）；③ 主信号 L_jepa（dropped 组）不受此污染，受影响仅 L_anchor 且为软污染（可视作温和 JEPA）；④ design 明确分阶段、novelty 裁决推迟到 Stage-C 带对照。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:166:- 既有正确点复核无回退：kpn 按原 crop 归一化、resize 纯缩放不变、grid clip 无 off-by-one、einsum masked-pool、`denom.clamp_min(1)`、`normalize(0)=0`、EMA over `parameters()`（swin 仅常量 buffer `relative_position_index`）、ckpt `backbone.` 前缀（对 `init_weights:1352-1354` 剥前缀往返一致、`keys()[0]` 不空）、semantic_weight 0.2 对齐下游——v1/v2 已逐项确认。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:169:- L1 w_var √C-标定后梯度 ~27× 于 v2（intended，留意是否过度白化，可调 w_var）；L2 union 路 0 可见 → L_union=1 常数（罕见）；L3 `DEV='cuda'` 硬编码；L4 predictor 同模块每 step 被 part[320,C]/union[64,C] 两次前向（各用自身 batch 统计、不存盘 → 无害）；L5 无 AMP/warmup/cosine、EMA 不 ramp——次优非错。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:14:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3145:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:15:"novel_component": "The per-batch \"shielding pixel pool\": clothing-region pixels are shuffled across the whole batch and each target pixel is replaced by a randomly sampled pool pixel, then a feature-consistency (MSE) loss aligns the corrupted-view feature with the clean-view feature — a self-supervised way to force invariance to a chosen semantic region without relying on holistic-only features or generative models.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./experiments/exp351_undetach_deocc/codex_review.md:7:codex 审查通过。PoseWeightedPool 真无参数(无 nn.Parameter/Linear,make_optimizer 不加任何参数);i2t/t2i 对齐梯度经无参数池化直接流进 backbone(featmaps[-1]),这正是 A(exp343=57.6 有 learnable query/k_proj 吸收)的针对性修复;对齐目标是纯 ID 原型(pose_cond False,无 B 的姿态稀释);描述子 = raw GAP global(池化仅 train,无泄漏);scene_heatmaps None fallback;POSE_TEST_FEAT global 与 exp341 描述子等价(单变量成立)。Verdict: approve。
./experiments/exp351_undetach_deocc/claude_review.md:16:- 因此 `make_optimizer`（`solver/make_optimizer.py:7` 遍历 `named_parameters()` 跳过 `requires_grad=False`）对该模块**不新增任何参数组**。对齐梯度在池化内无可学习落点 → 只能沿 `w·tokens` 流入 `featmaps[-1]`。**这正是 Option A 吸收陷阱的针对性修复**。
./experiments/exp351_undetach_deocc/claude_review.md:20:- `_run_backbone_with_psg`（`pose_backbone_model.py:415-504`）返回 `outs`，**全程无 `.detach()`** 落在 featmap 上（唯一 `.detach()` 在 447 行，作用于 PosePrompt 的 `hm_with_bg` argmax，与本实验无关且 PosePrompt 未开）。`featmaps[-1] = outs[-1]` 是活的 backbone 张量。
./experiments/exp351_undetach_deocc/claude_review.md:21:- forward `pose_backbone_model.py:617-618`：`use_clip_id_noparam_pool and scene_heatmaps is not None` → `feat_for_clip = self.pose_weighted_pool(featmaps[-1], scene_heatmaps)`（**非 detach 输入**）。
./experiments/exp351_undetach_deocc/claude_review.md:22:- 完整链路：`clip_id_loss → img_proj(623) → clip_id_proj(Linear, 215) → pose_weighted_pool(无参数) → featmaps[-1] → backbone`。BACKBONE 拿到梯度，确认修复成立。
./experiments/exp351_undetach_deocc/claude_review.md:32:- exp347 路径返回（`pose_backbone_model.py:894-895`）：`cls_score, global_feat, featmaps, None, {'clip_id_loss': ...}`。携带的特征是 `global_feat`（raw GAP, 501-502 行），**不是** `feat_for_clip`。de-occluded 特征**仅**用于 CLIP 对齐 loss，绝不做描述子或 triplet anchor。
./experiments/exp351_undetach_deocc/claude_review.md:52:- `pose` 显式 `.float()` → float32；`w`（softmax）float32；`tokens=featmaps[-1]` 在 autocast 下通常 float16 → `einsum('bn,bnc->bc', w_fp32, tokens_fp16)` 为混合 dtype。
./experiments/exp351_undetach_deocc/claude_review.md:72:**审查通过**。PoseWeightedPool 经 AST 校验确认真无参数；梯度路径 `clip_id_loss → clip_id_proj → 无参数池化 → featmaps[-1] → backbone` 完整无 detach，构成 Option A 吸收陷阱的有效修复；对齐目标为纯 ID 原型（pose_cond=False，无姿态污染，隔离 Option B 失败模式）；描述子为 raw GAP global、池化严格 train-only；AMP 混合 dtype einsum 有 exp343/Option A 同模式跑通先例；与 exp341 的唯一功能变量为 `POSE_CLIP_ID_NOPARAM_POOL`（`POSE_TEST_FEAT` 差异已证描述子等价，非第二变量）。无 Critical/High/Medium 问题，2 项 Low 均为澄清性、无需修复。可进入 Codex 审查。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:31:- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。

./experiments/exp251/claude_review.md:169:LGPA-D uses `featmaps[-1]` (Stage 3 output, detached if `_lgpa_detach=True`). Stage 2 PSG does NOT affect `featmaps[-1]` directly -- it only affects Stage 2 features which are then downsampled and passed through Stage 3. Stage 2 PSG indirectly affects Stage 3 features via the information flow: Stage 2 PSG -> downsample -> Stage 3 blocks (with Stage 3 PSG) -> featmaps[-1].
./experiments/exp251/claude_review.md:171:When `_lgpa_detach=True`, LGPA operates on `featmaps[-1].detach()`, so LGPA gradients do NOT flow back through Stage 2 or Stage 3 PSG. CORRECT.
./experiments/exp251/claude_review.md:173:GCN also uses `featmaps[-1].detach()` (L530). CORRECT.
./experiments/exp251/claude_review.md:175:Stage 2 features: `featmaps[-2]` is passed to GCN as `stage2_feat` (L531). With multi-stage PSG, this Stage 2 output is now PSG+PAA modulated. This means GCN gets pose-enhanced Stage 2 features. This is a FEATURE, not a bug -- it's part of the expected behavior of multi-stage injection.
./experiments/exp251/claude_review.md:179:LGPA test uses `featmaps[-1]` (not detached at test time). GCN test also uses `featmaps[-1]` (L723-724). Same reasoning -- Stage 2 PSG indirectly affects these through the backbone forward pass.
./experiments/exp251/claude_review.md:238:| (g) LGPA-D interaction | PASS | Uses featmaps[-1] only, Stage 2 PSG enriches indirectly |

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:146:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3444:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5079:reassess/r_3.md:3040:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2269:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:44:Web novelty 快查：AGPReID 近作主要是视角/语义/几何对齐，如 [VDT/CARGO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14513)、[AG-ReID.v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02634)、[GSAlign](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268)、[ViSA 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18192)。低分辨率/退化鲁棒 ReID 也已有先例，如 [Resolution-invariant ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.09748)、[RAIN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.10843)、[Degradation Invariance Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.04933)。AIRL 不应把“降质一致性”单独当强 novelty；更可讲的是 AG-ReID 场景里的梯度隔离 clean/recover 双头与固定融合互补，但方向固定 claim 需要降级。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:188:先例检索：AG-ReID.v2 已明确 aerial-ground 的 viewpoint/pose/resolution 问题；CARGO/VDT 是 view-decoupling 路线；DIL 做 degradation-invariance；RAR 做 resolution-adaptive metric；MRJL 做 multi-resolution dual-branch fusion；GSAlign/ViSA/SD-ReID 覆盖 alignment、view-aware、生成式补全。AIRL 不宜声称“退化一致性”或“双分支”本身新，较稳的新意只能放在“非对称 ground degradation + 梯度隔离 recover head + fixed soft-fuse”的组合证据上。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:21479:../airl_related_work.md:29:> Unlike view-alignment (VDT/GSAlign) or resolution-invariance (DI-REID/CRReID) approaches, AIRL reframes aerial-ground ReID as **observation-limited identity recoverability**: it does not align views or erase degradation, but models the recoverable-evidence ceiling under an aerial pixel budget via an asymmetric ground-degradation consistency, and fuses a clean and a recover evidence head with a fixed prior — recovering the directional trade-off into a net gain without dynamic routing.
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:21619:../airl_dualbranch_result.md:36:- **梯度隔离**(死穴的修复):`_forward_swin_split` 先跑完整 f_full stage 循环(在 stage `iso_stage` 输入处 **捕获 `x.detach()` + `semantic_weight.detach()`**),rec 拷贝在循环**之后**跑。detach 是隔离边界:f_rec 的 consistency + ID-CE 梯度只更新 rec 末段 + BNNeck_rec,**永不回流共享 trunk**。clean trunk + f_full 因此保持"干净极",f_rec 学"recover 极"。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:204:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4011:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1373:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5307:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=从相邻领域搬训练范式: 'LR bbox/采样格点是要边缘化的隐变量'这设定, 哪个相邻领域训练机制能映射且避开invariance-collapse? 候选评估: amortized-variational-inference(把marginalization学进网络)/detection-jitter-robust-training/test-time-training训练侧/super-resolution-as-auxiliary/deep-equilibrium/EM-style-latent。求: 最值1-2个 + 具体机制 + 廉价kill-switch + novelty(联网查) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:5401:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:5453:- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:5521:参数化 cvpb 加 `--dataset msmt17`（msmt17_split 读 list 文件）+ `--semantic_weight` override。**msmt17_split 数据读取完全正确**（q 11659/g 82161 标准 count，pid 0-3059 同空间，img 存在，q⊂g）。但 **MSMT17 ckpt 的 model config 配对是深坑**：正确 config `swin_small_pose.yml` 已被删（缺失），现有 `pose_backbone_psg_small.yml`（sw=0.2）/swin_small.yml（baseline 无 pose_dict 报错）都不匹配 ckpt 训练（sw=0.6 + pose-mul-scale0.3 + llw0.7）；SANITY 持续 2.67~4.29（特征垃圾，非数据问题）。**止损留用户**（用正确 config 或重训），不无限 debug 缺失 config。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:4768:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20146:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. ./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6129:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6162:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6771:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2628:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens1_align.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=对齐/规范化而非不变: 既然nuisance主要是LR bbox-crop不确定性, 训练一个模块**学着把LR crop对齐/重定心**(类spatial transformer/学到的re-centering/sub-pixel配准)让特征canonicalize而非collapse(训练降lattice spread+测试边缘化残差)。求: 具体机制(网络结构/loss/怎么和marginalization接) + 为何不重蹈invariance-collapse + 廉价kill-switch(冻结/小实验先验) + novelty(联网查STN-ReID/AlignedReID/sub-pixel-registration/spatial-alignment先例) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12144:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12460:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12673:Web novelty 快查：AGPReID 近作主要是视角/语义/几何对齐，如 [VDT/CARGO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14513)、[AG-ReID.v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02634)、[GSAlign](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268)、[ViSA 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18192)。低分辨率/退化鲁棒 ReID 也已有先例，如 [Resolution-invariant ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.09748)、[RAIN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.10843)、[Degradation Invariance Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.04933)。AIRL 不应把“降质一致性”单独当强 novelty；更可讲的是 AG-ReID 场景里的梯度隔离 clean/recover 双头与固定融合互补，但方向固定 claim 需要降级。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12718:Web novelty 快查：AGPReID 近作主要是视角/语义/几何对齐，如 [VDT/CARGO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14513)、[AG-ReID.v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02634)、[GSAlign](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268)、[ViSA 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18192)。低分辨率/退化鲁棒 ReID 也已有先例，如 [Resolution-invariant ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.09748)、[RAIN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.10843)、[Degradation Invariance Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.04933)。AIRL 不应把“降质一致性”单独当强 novelty；更可讲的是 AG-ReID 场景里的梯度隔离 clean/recover 双头与固定融合互补，但方向固定 claim 需要降级。

AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2395:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens1_align.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=对齐/规范化而非不变: 既然nuisance主要是LR bbox-crop不确定性, 训练一个模块**学着把LR crop对齐/重定心**(类spatial transformer/学到的re-centering/sub-pixel配准)让特征canonicalize而非collapse(训练降lattice spread+测试边缘化残差)。求: 具体机制(网络结构/loss/怎么和marginalization接) + 为何不重蹈invariance-collapse + 廉价kill-switch(冻结/小实验先验) + novelty(联网查STN-ReID/AlignedReID/sub-pixel-registration/spatial-alignment先例) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3179:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:146:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. ./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3406:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:204:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4098:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:15:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=表达不确定性而非压掉: 训练模型**输出lattice诱导的不确定性**(per-sample spread/方差/置信), 把test-time的K-marginalization部分amortize进一个学到的不确定性头, 测试时用它加权/校准retrieval。求: 具体机制(heteroscedastic回归? lattice-variance head? 怎么监督?) + 为何不collapse + 廉价kill-switch + novelty(联网查uncertainty-ReID/PFE-probabilistic-embedding/DUL-data-uncertainty先例, ★必须说清怎么不撞PFE) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4221:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4251:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:22:- **novelty**：STN/AlignedReID/PAN/STNReID/CDPM 先例多 → 卖点不是"用 STN"，是"LR detector crop lattice 当可边缘化隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 decision marginalization"组合无先例。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4265:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:25:2. **方法（test-time）**: 决策级 lattice marginalization（K 变体 + mean/max/logsumexp 聚合），并证明 **decision-level marginalization > training-level invariance**。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4276:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:58:- Alignment（STN/AlignedReID/STNReID/PAN/CDPM）: 若用 B LC-STN，卖点是"LR crop lattice 当隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 marginalization"组合无先例。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4285:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4289:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4649:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:146:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2050:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1187:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:146:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2817:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:4230:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5786:reassess/r_3.md:7873:./reassess/r_3.md:3041:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2270:./validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2818:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:4233:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5814:reassess/r_3.md:7966:./reassess/r_3.md:4148:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12144:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3025:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review.md:8:- **High-1** [line 173]: 每图 RNG `seed+idx` → 每 epoch 同一组 lattice variants（无多样性，废掉 lattice-invariance 学习）。**修**: `LatticeTrainSet.set_epoch(ep)` 每 epoch 调 + seed 混 epoch（`seed = cli.seed*1000003 + epoch*9973 + idx*2654435761`）；DataLoader persistent_workers 默认 False → worker 每 epoch 重 fork 看新 epoch。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3057:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:17:2. **方法（test-time）**: 决策级 lattice marginalization（K 变体 + mean/max/logsumexp 聚合），并证明 **decision-level marginalization > training-level invariance**。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3061:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:24:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3065:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:36:- Aliasing（BlurPool）: shift-variance 已知，但我们不是"发现 aliasing"，是"把 sampling lattice 当可边缘化隐变量"。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3066:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:37:- Alignment（STN/AlignedReID/STNReID/PAN/CDPM）: 若用 B LC-STN，卖点是"LR crop lattice 当隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 marginalization"组合无先例。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3086:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:41:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3116:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3119:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3145:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3171:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:6:训练端做 invariance / feature-collapse 压判别性 = 死路：consistency −1.73、lattice-aug 不特殊 +0.54、L_marg 训练有害大元凶。新机制必须绕开"逼 K 变体特征塌成一个点"。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3179:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:22:- **novelty**：STN/AlignedReID/PAN/STNReID/CDPM 先例多 → 卖点不是"用 STN"，是"LR detector crop lattice 当可边缘化隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 decision marginalization"组合无先例。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3208:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3215:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3221:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3379:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:146:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4197:experiments/exp251/claude_review.md:169:LGPA-D uses `featmaps[-1]` (Stage 3 output, detached if `_lgpa_detach=True`). Stage 2 PSG does NOT affect `featmaps[-1]` directly -- it only affects Stage 2 features which are then downsampled and passed through Stage 3. Stage 2 PSG indirectly affects Stage 3 features via the information flow: Stage 2 PSG -> downsample -> Stage 3 blocks (with Stage 3 PSG) -> featmaps[-1].
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4198:experiments/exp251/claude_review.md:171:When `_lgpa_detach=True`, LGPA operates on `featmaps[-1].detach()`, so LGPA gradients do NOT flow back through Stage 2 or Stage 3 PSG. CORRECT.

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4639:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2050:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1187:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:146:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6401:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:21479:../airl_related_work.md:29:> Unlike view-alignment (VDT/GSAlign) or resolution-invariance (DI-REID/CRReID) approaches, AIRL reframes aerial-ground ReID as **observation-limited identity recoverability**: it does not align views or erase degradation, but models the recoverable-evidence ceiling under an aerial pixel budget via an asymmetric ground-degradation consistency, and fuses a clean and a recover evidence head with a fixed prior — recovering the directional trade-off into a net gain without dynamic routing.
